sentences: A transversal matroid records which subsets can be matched into the opposite side of a bipartite incidence graph.
A linear representation instead encodes independence through linear independence of matrix columns.
The textbook asks for a deterministic polynomial-time construction translating the former representation into the latter.
Such a construction would remove randomness from algebraic algorithms that rely on representing these combinatorial independence systems.
The saved note does not specify field-size or encoding conventions, so the desired deterministic construction still needs those representation details for a complete statement.
